career_ladder.note: SSC Constable (General Duty) recruits the frontline armed security personnel for the Central Armed Police Forces (BSF, CISF, CRPF, ITBP, SSB), Secretariat Security Force (SSF), and Assam Rifles under the Ministry of Home Affairs. Personnel advance through the subordinate combatised executive cadre.

exam_scheme.note: SSC GD Constable recruitment consists of a Computer Based Examination (CBE, 80 questions, 160 marks, 60 minutes, 0.25 negative marking per incorrect answer), followed by mandatory qualifying Physical Standard Test (PST), Physical Efficiency Test (PET: 5 km run in 24 min for male, 1.6 km in 8.5 min for female), and Detailed Medical Examination (DME/RME).

financial_package.pay_source_label: 7th CPC Pay Matrix, Table 5 (Civilian/CAPF Employees), Government of India
financial_package.estimate_note: Calculated at Level 3 entry basic pay (₹21,700) with 58% DA (₹12,586). Troops deployed in high-risk operational sectors (J&K border, North East counter-insurgency, and Left Wing Extremism theatres) receive Risk and Hardship Allowance ranging from ₹6,000 up to ₹17,300 per month.
official_perks: Subsidised CAPF family residential accommodation or HRA
Central Police Canteen (CLPK) grocery and consumer goods concessions
Risk & Hardship Allowance based on operational posting matrix
Free ration money allowance / mess allowance (approx. ₹3,900/month)
Uniform washing/maintenance allowance and defined NPS retirement coverage

competition_benchmarks.note: SSC Constable (GD) is the largest uniformed security recruitment drive in the nation, drawing 40-50 lakh candidates. The 2025 examination cycle notified 39,481 vacancies across BSF, CISF, CRPF, SSB, ITBP, AR, and SSF. The 2024 cycle concluded with 46,617 vacancies, while 2022 filled 50,187 vacancies.
